name: Kano Lefthand
source:
Daughter of a powerful marquess, Kano had originally been disowned by her father because of a carnal relationship she developed with a local boy. She then devoted her life to train and become a Sentinel, until all her family members suddenly died of a mysterious disease.

As the last member of her household, she had no choice but to return home and inherit the title of marquise. While Kano isn’t exactly talented in politics, she’s a proud Ranger who specializes in scouting and assassination. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1268&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]Mangagamer[/url]]
